claude_proposed_widenings.name: subclass_grant
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The feature's entire mechanic is a character-build branching point: at level 3 the player chooses a subclass and gains its features for the rest of their career. This is not an activation (no cost, no resource, no reset cadence, no effect). No existing ClassFeatureMechanics family can encode a build-time subclass selection. ClassFeatureActivationMechanics requires activationCost + resource + resetCadence + effect, none of which are applicable. ClassFeatureEffect only covers GrantExtraActionEffect and HealHpEffect — neither represents 'choose a specialization path'.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You gain a Fighter subclass of your choice. The Champion subclass is detailed after this class's description. A subclass is a specialization that grants you features at certain Fighter levels. For the rest of your career, you gain each of your subclass's features that are of your Fighter level or lower.
